messages.text: "Unify the duplicated export pipeline without changing public behavior. Keep src/csv_exporter.py.export_csv(rows) and src/json_exporter.py.export_json(rows) returning the exact same strings, including header and final newline rules. Introduce src/exporter.py.export_rows(rows, format) supporting 'csv' and 'json', and ValueError for unsupported formats. Both public wrappers must call that shared entry point; remove their duplicated row normalization and serialization loops. Normalization chooses only id and name, uses '' for missing or None values, stringifies other values, preserves order and supports one-shot iterables without mutating inputs. JSON uses ensure_ascii=False and separators=(',', ':'). CSV uses LF line endings, standard CSV quoting and an id,name header even with no rows. The existing dispatcher must keep working. Start in src/dispatcher.py and the two exporter modules."
